verdict.rationale: gstack keeps a public CHANGELOG.md with substantive, user-facing entries (for example, terminal-driven checks and the pricing and model-snapshot changes), and the /gstack-upgrade skill 'shows what's new' as part of the upgrade. Because the changelog is public, a developer can read it before updating, but the documented upgrade flow appears to show changes only while or after running the upgrade. Missing for 10: an explicit preview of changes before applying the upgrade, evidence of per-release versioned notes or tags tied to skill changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
